system_a.summary: Across the reviews, the most consistent strengths are the location (close to downtown Asheville, restaurants and breweries, with some walkability), private entrance and on-site parking, easy check-in, and responsive host communication. Recent guests (2024–2026) describe a clean, spacious basement apartment with a comfortable bed, full kitchen, coffee bar, honor-system drinks and snacks, and a sauna. Recurring limitations include a basic or dated feel, little natural light, and a small bathroom. The main recurring concern is noise: some guests heard footsteps from upstairs, with 2025–2026 reviews describing it as manageable, mainly daytime and evening, and eased by a noise machine or headphones. Older reviews also raised a shared laundry room and an interior connection to the upstairs. A single 2016 review reported severe cleanliness and pest problems, and another 2016 review described dingy conditions; recent reviews do not repeat these. These are guest reports, not verified current conditions.

system_b.summary: Reviews of this basement-style unit near Asheville are mostly positive, though several concerns deserve attention. Location is the most consistently praised feature: guests describe a short ride or drive to downtown and nearby restaurants, with Uber fares of $4-7, while one 2016 guest reported a mile to downtown and a $20 peak fare. Cleanliness is generally praised through 2026, but two 2016 reviews described bugs, mildew and a dirty bed. Noise is split: footsteps were reported in 2018, 2025 and 2026, while others heard nothing. Privacy concerns, a 2016 internal door and a 2018 unlocked shared laundry room, sit beside many praising the private entrance; present status is unconfirmed. Hosts are widely called responsive, check-in easy, and parking flat. Amenities, including a sauna in 2023-2026 reports, are praised, though early reviews noted no TV and dated furnishings.

selected_claims.claim: Location is the most consistently praised feature: reviewers describe it as close to downtown Asheville (short Uber or drive), with restaurants walkable and easy to find. One 2016 review disputed this, citing about a mile to downtown, no bike access and a $20 peak Uber fare; other reviews cite $4-7 fares.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praised across 2016-2026, including recent years; the dissent is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Downtown is not walkable per several reviewers; Uber cost varies by time.

selected_claims.claim: Upstairs footsteps/noise is a recurring but split issue. Some reviewers found the unit very quiet or heard nothing, while others heard footsteps. One 2018 guest said thin floors carried footsteps past midnight; a 2025 guest found it mild with a noise machine; a 2026 guest heard footsteps 7am-9pm and used headphones.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Footstep reports in 2018, 2025 and 2026; quiet reports through 2025-2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Noise likely depends on upstairs occupancy and guest sensitivity; evidence is self-reported.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy and security concerns exist alongside many privacy-positive reviews. A 2016 guest reported an internal door/stairway linking the unit to the host's upstairs space and feared entry when returning late; a 2018 guest found the shared laundry room, accessible to an upstairs tenant, unlocked on arrival. Many others praised the private entrance and privacy, and a solo female traveler felt safe in 2023.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Concerns date from 2016 and 2018; no recent reports of them, but no evidence of change either.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Cannot confirm whether the door or laundry-room arrangement is unchanged or locked now.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness is overwhelmingly reported as clean, including recent reviews. Two early 2016 reviews were strongly negative, citing a filthy bed, bugs, mildew and a musty couch.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negatives are from 2016; positives continue through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No evidence either way on whether the 2016 problems were resolved, though later reviews rarely mention them.

selected_claims.claim: Listing accuracy is mostly confirmed (as described/advertised), but there are dissenting reports: misleading photos and a torn couch (2016), less private than described due to the shared laundry room (2018), and no TV despite the listing (2018, per reviewer).
selected_claims.uncertainty: The TV claim is the reviewer's reading of the listing.

selected_claims.claim: Comfort is generally praised, especially the beds, linens and coziness. Minority complaints cover worn or dated furnishings, a dark basement with little natural light, a small bathroom, and heat controlled by the upstairs house (2016). A separate AC unit and fans were provided per a 2019 guest.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed praise spans 2017-2025; dated or worn comments are mostly 2016-2019, plus 2022.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Whether the furnishings have since been updated is unclear; one 2023 reviewer noted upgrades in progress.

selected_claims.claim: Check-in is described as easy and flexible, with clear instructions. Parking is private, steps from the entrance, and flat, which a 2024 reviewer contrasted with steep slopes at other Asheville rentals. A 2016 guest reported an upstairs guest blocking the driveway.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Easy check-in reported through 2026; the blocked-driveway incident was in 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No formal accessibility details (such as steps inside) are given.

selected_claims.claim: The host is widely described as responsive, friendly and accommodating, with flexibility on timing. One 2016 reviewer called the host unhelpful and unreachable on a weekend.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Positive reports run 2016-2025; the single negative is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: The negative is a single report.

selected_claims.claim: Amenities are praised: full kitchen, coffee bar, honor-system snacks and beer, toiletries, strong water pressure, and (from 2023 reviews) a sauna. Gaps noted: no TV or cable in early reviews, a spartan feel, and an oddly organized kitchen. A 2022 guest mentioned a Roku TV.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Sauna reports are from 2023-2026; TV complaints from 2016-2019.

selected_claims.claim: Value is mostly seen as good or budget-friendly, though some say it is no-frills or you get what you pay for. A 2016 guest judged $150/night poor value versus a cheap hotel.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative value view from 2016; positive through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Current pricing is not in the evidence.
